acceptance: Exact TPC-DS per-query row counts at the sub-SF1 scales the corpus uses, generated with the bundled dsdgen/dsqgen and agreed by at least two engines
Parameter-sensitive queries identified and skipped for non-reference parameters
SQL and DataFrame TPC-DS sub-SF1 runs check every fixed query; a mutated count fails
Generator and provenance follow the TPC-H reference pattern from #3068
description: Gap deferred from the subscale ranking work: #3068 adds exact SF 0.01/0.1 references for TPC-H only. TPC-DS sub-SF1 runs are now ranked (TPC-DS SF 0.1 has 3 identities after #3075) but have no per-query row-count oracle: the DataFrame path always skips TPC-DS (benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py:114, "TPC-DS expected row counts are not seed-aligned"), and SQL sub-SF1 runs check only table row counts, schema and integrity (benchbox/platforms/base/phase_tracking.py, _determine_overall_validation_status in result_capture.py). So a wrong TPC-DS subscale answer still ranks as passed. Found while scoping owner decision 4 (TPC-DS follows the same rule) for subscale-tpc-ranking-policy-20261016.
